save_state_dict_checkpoint: save a distributed model state_dict to filesystem using FileSystemWriter with SPMD style
save_distributed_checkpoint: save a distributed model checkpoint handling ShardedTensor and DTensor shards per rank
async_save_checkpoint: asynchronously save a state_dict by offloading to CPU and running save in a background thread
save_no_dist_checkpoint: save a state_dict without initializing a process group by passing no_dist=True
save_stateful_objects: save state_dict containing Stateful objects by calling state_dict method before serialization
